description: List a business's customers who booked a week last year (for example Thanksgiving week) and have not booked the same week this year, biggest last-year spend first, from the orders in the business's connected booking system. Each row has the customer's name and company, a masked phone, whether there is an email, and last year's order numbers, dates and totals. Returns email_ready_lead_ids (recorded email permission, not on the do-not-email list) to pass straight to draft_email_campaign, and call_list (name, phone, last-year total) for staff to dial by hand: Kai never calls or texts these past customers. Customers whose details have not been looked up yet show contact 'not_looked_up'; prepare_rebook_customers fills them in. Read-only; needs a connected booking system.

business_id.description: Required when the account has more than one business.

holiday.description: Compare this holiday's week last year with the same week this year (Monday to Sunday around the holiday; Memorial Day and Labor Day take the seven days ending on the holiday; new-years is the week of New Year's Eve). Use this or this_year_start/this_year_end.

last_year_end.description: Optional: last day of the earlier range.

last_year_start.description: Optional: first day of the earlier range. Default: the same weekdays 52 weeks before.

this_year_end.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive, at most 92 days).

this_year_start.description: Optional instead of holiday: first day, YYYY-MM-DD.

year.description: Optional with holiday: the year to fill (default: this year). Last year's week is the year before.

name: find_rebook_customers
title: Find Customers To Rebook
